intro: Choosing the right area matters more than the hotel itself in Nan. Here are the main neighborhoods, who each suits, and where to book for your travel style.

blocks.html: Short answer: For a first visit stay in Nan town (near Wat Phumin and the walking street — easy to explore and eat on foot). For a chilled feel choose the Nan riverside; for terraced fields and mountains pick Pua district (north, near Doi Phu Kha) or, deeper in, Bo Kluea/Sapan with its scenic mountains — the northern zones need a car.

faq.q: Where should I stay in Nan for a first visit?
faq.a: Nan town is best for a first visit — near Wat Phumin, the walking street and restaurants, walkable with rooms for every budget. For nature, head north later to Pua and Doi Phu Kha.

faq.q: Where to stay for Doi Phu Kha / Pua?
faq.a: Stay in Pua district for Doi Phu Kha, terraced fields and mountain-view cafés — about an hour from Nan town, and you will want a car. For deeper exploring, you can also stay around Bo Kluea/Sapan.

faq.q: How many days do I need in Nan?
faq.a: Two to three days for the town and its beautiful temples, plus 1–2 more for Pua, Doi Phu Kha and Bo Kluea. Nan is a slow, unhurried destination — great for nature and culture lovers.
